create_checkerboard: create a cached checkerboard pattern numpy array of given height and width dimensions
read_image_with_scale: read an image file and optionally resize it by a scale factor using bilinear resampling
save_image_format: save a PIL image to disk with format-specific quality and optimization parameters
normalize_array_percentile: normalize a numpy array using percentile clipping and optional gamma correction
visualize_array_colormap: visualize a 2D numpy array as a colored image using a specified OpenCV colormap
